summary: Filters a collision node linked list. Reads the active list head from this+0x20 and stores it as the iterator at this+0x28. Walks the active list; a node is kept when FieldCompareConstant and FloatComparisonCheck both pass, or when |node+0x370 float - this+0x30 threshold| <= 2.5. Kept nodes just advance the iterator through the node+4 next link. Culled nodes are unlinked from the active list (fixing head this+0x20, tail this+0x24, iterator this+0x28 and count this+0x2C), their payload freed when the node+8 flag byte is set (EmptyStub_0170 + FreeWrapper_7bcf), the node freed, then a replacement allocated via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12)/ShortComputation_ac20 and inserted into an output list (head this+0x10, anchor pair this+0x14/this+0x18, count this+0x1C). Returns the final iterator value.

operations.description: result = active list head (this+0x20); store it as the iterator at this+0x28.
If the active list head is non-null, enter the filtering walk.
Walk the active list while the iterator (this+0x28) is non-null; the node value i is read from the iterator node's +0 slot (field *(this+0x28):0).
Keep test: node is kept when (FieldCompareConstant(i) && FloatComparisonCheck(i)) or |node+0x370 float - this+0x30 threshold| <= 2.5.
Keep path: advance the iterator this+0x28 to the current node's next link (node+4, field *(this+0x28):4).

Cull path: unlink the node (matched by +0 value) from the active list, fixing head this+0x20, tail this+0x24, iterator this+0x28 and the count this+0x2C; free the payload when the node+8 flag byte is set (EmptyStub_0170 then FreeWrapper_7bcf), then free the node itself.
Allocate a replacement output node: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12); on success ShortComputation_ac20(i, 0), otherwise null.

Insert the new node into the output list: if the output head this+0x10 is non-null, link the new node's +4 to it; otherwise initialize the anchor pair this+0x14 and this+0x18 to the new node; then set this+0x10 = new node and increment the output count this+0x1C.
Return the final iterator value (this+0x28), null when the walk exhausted the list.
